about: The reviewed verdicts of the two-reader rule (verify/agree.js): one per class-B pair (both readers read the sentence and disagree), keyed by reader2’s sentence (owner|source|index). Each was checked by hand against GW’s text in verify/.cache (scratchpad reader-cmp, round 5 against main 0b5f785, 2 Nov 2026). verdict: “app right …” or “both right …” confirms the app’s box (V in data.js AGREE) when quotes holds GW’s words, each found in verify/.cache (check Q); any other verdict leaves the box to fall back. gw: the review’s note; quotes: GW’s words it stands on; pair: the fingerprint of the pair as reviewed (check S: a changed pair makes the verdict stale; review it again, then node verify/agree.js --bind ID).

ds:thousand-sons/rubric-marines|Icon of.gw: “Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit (excluding CHARACTERS) have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.” The app's scope is nonchar and reader2 reads bearerUnit excluding CHARACTER: the same meaning.
quotes: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit (excluding CHARACTERS) have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

quotes: … targets an Infantry, Mounted or Beasts unit, each successful unmodified Wound roll is a Critical Wound.

faction:imperial-knights|Code Chivalric.severity: none: the duration is now on the box (fixed on main); model ≡ unit for a one-model Knight
faction:imperial-knights|Code Chivalric.gw: Code Chivalric: “Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.” Quality: “Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.” Every Imperial Knights model with Code Chivalric is a one-model unit in these lists, so model ≡ unit.
quotes: Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.
Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.

faction:adeptus-mechanicus|Doctrina Impe.verdict: both right (the app splits the row over two pick boxes and a part)
faction:adeptus-mechanicus|Doctrina Impe.gw: Conqueror Imperative (errata): “Ranged weapons … have the [ASSAULT] ability. / Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons … by 1. / Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.” The app: ranged pick “Conqueror” = [ASSAULT] with part AP+1 (battleline6); melee pick “Conqueror” = WS+1. reader2: the three rows, AP+1 under battleline6. Same reading; the comparator cannot line a pick split across boxes up automatically.
quotes: Ranged weapons … have the [ASSAULT] ability. / Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons … by 1. / Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and/or it is within 6" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE units, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

ds:thousand-sons/daemon-prince-of-tzeent.gw: “Each time this model makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 (if that attack targets a PSYKER CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead).” The app has two boxes (CHARACTER: re-roll 1s; PSYKER+CHARACTER: full re-rolls). reader2 has the same, with the parenthesis as an “instead” alternative. The diff is the comparator matching two targetKw at once.
quotes: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1 (if that attack targets a PSYKER CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead).

Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the selected ability.” The app has a pick (lethal | sus) with opt Diabolic Power and the Empowered words. reader2 reads the same options on the second sentence, with Empowered. det:tyranids/synaptic-nexus|Irresistible.severity: latent (no list): the app box has no reach, so only the stratagem’s SYNAPSE unit would see it
det:tyranids/synaptic-nexus|Irresistible.gw: “TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit from your army …, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.”
